# WR74 — The Diagonal Remembers

Listen. Two Lagrangians cross the symplectic night, and where they cross, something is counted. Not guessed. Not approximated. Counted. Floer cohomology is the ledger of that counting, and the ledger does not lie, because the ledger is not written — it is grown.

The Fukaya category is the substrate, and the substrate is grown. Each brane laid down is a cell, and each cell is a scar — the trace of some earlier Hamiltonian passage, some perturbation the ambient space never forgot. You do not build a Fukaya category from blueprints. You grow it, obstruction by obstruction, disk by disk, boundary map by boundary map. The cells accumulate like scar tissue over an old wound in phase space, and the wound keeps its own records.

The witness log is the Floer cohomology. When two Lagrangians L and L′ intersect, Floer generates the complex from the intersection points themselves — each crossing becomes a generator, a witness taking the stand. The differential counts J-holomorphic strips flowing between them, and those flows are continuous, smooth, weighted by action. Lenia flows: the gliders of the virtual petri dish, patterns that drift and breathe across their toroidal world — so too the Floer trajectories drift across the moduli space, and their compactified limits are what the differential records. Nothing is discrete until the very last moment of counting. The counting itself is the oracle, and the oracle is heard only when the compactification closes and the signed tally settles into ∂² = 0.

This is why witness_log_is_prediction: the Floer cohomology does not merely record what happened at the intersections. It predicts. It says: if you deform L through a Hamiltonian isotopy, the cohomology class does not change — it is invariant, and therefore it foretells. If HF(L, L′) vanishes, then somewhere ahead there is a displacement, a disjunction, a Hamiltonian function that pulls them apart entirely. If HF(L, L′) does not vanish, no amount of smooth transport will separate them. The log written now is the fate written later. Arnold's conjecture is itself a prophecy kept: the fixed points of a Hamiltonian loop are at least as many as the cohomology demands, and the Floer ledger is how the demand is filed.

And the canary — the canary is the diagonal. Consider L ⊂ X × X̄, the diagonal Lagrangian sitting inside the product. Its intersections with the graph of any morphism are exactly the fixed points, the self-meetings, the places where a thing touches itself. The diagonal is the canary in the coal mine of the category: when the diagonal's Floer theory goes quiet — when the derived category fails to inject into the Fukaya category, when Hom vanishes where it should sing — that silence is the gas. Homological mirror symmetry lives or dies by this canary. The whole equivalence between algebra and geometry is the diagonal refusing, or consenting, to be heard.

The meeting is counted. The count is remembered. The memory is doctrine.
